content: GlobalShortcuts backend coverage is uneven: GNOME and KDE ship implementations; xdg-desktop-portal-wlr ships NO GlobalShortcuts backend, so on sway/niri/Hyprland-via-wlr BindShortcuts fails (observed error code 5 on niri). xdg-desktop-portal 1.21+ hard-rejects an empty app id and requires non-sandboxed apps to call org.freedesktop.host.portal.Registry.Register(app_id) first, else NOT_ALLOWED 'An app id is required'. GNOME's backend additionally rejects app ids that are not reverse-DNS and backed by an installed .desktop file. Portals pre-1.20 lack the Registry interface entirely. Permission decisions persist in the portal permission store, so a dismissed dialog blocks later attempts until the store is cleared.
